name: ffmpeg
description: Local media with the system ffmpeg: probe, convert (fixed presets), trim, extract audio, thumbnails, resize, join, burn subtitles and GIFs, on files in allowed directories

nodes.title: Probe a media file
nodes.description: Reads a media file's container, duration, size, bit rate and streams (codec, resolution, frame rate, sample rate, channels, language) with ffprobe

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

include_raw.description: Also return ffprobe's full JSON (format and streams)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Convert a media file
nodes.description: Converts a video or audio file to another container/codec from a fixed preset menu (mp4, mov, mkv, webm, mp3, m4a, wav, flac, ogg, opus) at low, medium or high quality; writes a new file to FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

video_codec.description: Video codec (default: the format's first codec, e.g. h264 for mp4)

audio_codec.description: Audio codec (default: the format's first codec, e.g. aac for mp4)

extra_args.description: Workflow nodes only: extra output options from an allowlist (-crf, -preset, -tune, -b:v, -b:a, -maxrate, -bufsize, -r, -g, -ac, -ar, -pix_fmt, -profile:v, -level, -movflags, -q:a, -threads, -an, -vn, -sn), e.g. ["-preset", "slow"]

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Extract the audio track
nodes.description: Writes the first audio track of a video or audio file as mp3, m4a, wav, flac, ogg or opus to FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Resize a video
nodes.description: Scales a video to target_width and/or target_height (the missing side keeps the aspect ratio; with both, the video fits inside the box unless keep_aspect is false) and re-encodes it

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

keep_aspect.description: With both sides given, fit inside the box instead of stretching

format.description: Output format (default: the input's container if it is one of these, else mp4)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Cut a section
nodes.description: Cuts a section of a video or audio file between `start` and `end` (or `start` plus `duration`); re-encodes for frame accuracy, or copies streams (fast, cuts at keyframes) with accurate=false

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

duration.description: Length instead of end, seconds (e.g. 12.5) or HH:MM:SS[.fff]

accurate.description: Re-encode for an exact cut (false: copy streams, faster, keyframe-aligned)

format.description: Output format (default: the input's container if it is a preset, else mp4)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Join media files
nodes.description: Joins 2-50 video or audio files end to end. By default streams are copied (fast; all files must share codecs and sizes); reencode=true converts to a preset instead

inputs.description: Files in order, each inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS

format.description: Output format (default: the first file's container if it is a preset, else mp4)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Burn in subtitles
nodes.description: Renders the cues of a .srt subtitle file (inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS) into the video picture and re-encodes it

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

format.description: Output format (default: the input's container if it is a preset, else mp4)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Grab a frame
nodes.description: Saves one video frame at a given time as a jpg, png or webp image, optionally scaled to a width

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

target_width.description: Scale to this width in pixels (height keeps the aspect ratio)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Make a GIF
nodes.description: Turns up to 30 seconds of a video into an animated GIF with a generated palette (frame rate and width are capped)

input.description: Media file path inside FFMPEG_INPUT_DIRS (or FFMPEG_OUTPUT_DIR); absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first input directory

target_width.description: Width in pixels (height keeps the aspect ratio)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
